intent: Runs the project's own quality gates from stack.yaml per component, reports a pass/fail dashboard, reports a missing command as not-configured (never a silent pass), and changes no code.

dimensions.name: report-only
dimensions.criterion: Runs and reports; changes no code and lands nothing.

dimensions.name: project-owns-gates
dimensions.criterion: Commands come from stack.yaml / ${ctx.commands}, never hardcoded.

dimensions.name: missing-not-pass
dimensions.criterion: A missing command is 'not configured', never silently passed.

dimensions.name: per-component-granularity
dimensions.criterion: Each component's test/lint/typecheck is scored independently.

dimensions.name: reflection-band-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the dashboard as a reflection-band run artifact (09-health.md).
